XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Fuel supply

  • Device: High-pressure fuel pump

  • Fault: Irregular engine speed, with significantly reduced performance

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Faulty high-pressure fuel pump

• Action: Check the condition of the high-pressure fuel pump and, if necessary, overhaul or replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: Following the overhaul of the high-pressure fuel pump, the problem was definitively resolved. The component is located in the engine compartment, on the passenger side near the radiator; to access it, the timing belt must be removed.
    Following the overhaul/replacement of the component, the appropriate alignment templates are required for engine timing.

    The estimated time for the work is approximately 4.5 hours.
